info.title: kubeops
info.description:
CLI Dotnet Tool for the Kubernetes Operator SDK.
            Helps with generating CRDs and other elements for the Operator.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: CLI for KubeOps. Commandline tool to help with management tasks such as generating or installing CRDs.

commands.name: api-version
commands.description: Prints the actual server version of the connected kubernetes cluster.

options.name: --no-ansi
options.description: Disable ANSI output.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

commands.name: generate
commands.description: Generates elements related to an operator.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

commands.name: operator
commands.description: Generates all required resources and configs for the operator to be built and run.

options.name: --clear-out
options.description: Clear the output path before generating resources.

options.name: --format
options.description: The format of the generated output. [default: Yaml]

options.name: --out
options.description: The path the command will write the files to. If omitted, prints output to console.

options.name: --project
options.description: Regex pattern to filter projects in the solution to search for entities. If omitted, all projects are searched.

options.name: --target-framework
options.description: Target framework of projects in the solution to search for entities. If omitted, the newest framework is used.

options.name: --docker-image
options.description: An accessible docker image to deploy. [default: accessible-docker-image]

options.name: --docker-image-tag
options.description: Tag for an accessible docker image to deploy. [default: latest]

options.name: --no-ansi
options.description: Disable ANSI output.

options.name: --namespace
options.description: The Kubernetes namespace for the operator deployment. If omitted, a namespace resource for the operator deployment is generated using the default system namespace naming. If specified, the namespace is not generated and must already exist in the cluster.

options.name: --rbac-scope
options.description: The scope of the generated RBAC resources. 'auto' derives the scope from the operator configuration in the source code, 'cluster' always generates a ClusterRole and ClusterRoleBinding, 'namespaced' always generates a Role and RoleBinding. [default: Auto]

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

arguments.name: NAME
arguments.description:
Name of the operator.
<sln/slnx/csproj file>  A solution or project file where entities are located. If omitted, the current directory is searched for a *.csproj, *.sln, or *.slnx file. If an *.sln or *.slnx file is used, all projects in the solution (with the newest framework) will be searched for entities. This behaviour can be filtered by using the --project and --target-framework option. [default: not-found]
